fusions.name: Scatter Plague
fusions.desc: Spreads a plague that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bilge Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a gout that deals 9 damage and heals you for 35% of the damage dealt. Each cast costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stowaway
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Last Off the Wreck
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
